actions.mechanism: Store the descriptive claim separately from its wording and reevaluate it when referenced data changes.
actions.implementation: Attach stable metric/filter IDs, compared series, aggregation, and a predicate such as “A exceeds B.” Require review for claims without predicates.
actions.check: Refresh a fixture where A leads B, then B leads A; the original callout must become contradicted before export.
actions.risk: A predicate may capture only part of the prose.

actions.action: Represent missing evidence separately from zero
actions.mechanism: Explicit availability states prevent absent series and null observations from silently becoming numeric evidence.
actions.implementation: Distinguish present values, null observations, and absent series. Define claim-specific completeness requirements; show “evidence unavailable” when unmet, without substituting zero.
actions.check: Test an absent series, an all-null series, and a measured zero; each must produce a distinct status and display.
actions.risk: Partial observations can still bias aggregates unless completeness rules apply.

actions.action: Track the exact date and filter scope
actions.mechanism: Stable IDs identify references, while resolved scope records what observations actually supported the annotation.
actions.implementation: Save filter-definition versions, resolved date boundaries, timezone, and aggregation grain. On refresh, flag scope differences even when the descriptive predicate remains true.
actions.check: Shift a rolling date range while preserving its filter ID; surface the changed boundaries before export.
actions.risk: Rolling windows may generate frequent, legitimate review requests.

actions.action: Separate harmless revisions from material evidence changes
actions.mechanism: Claim-specific tolerances distinguish changed observations from changes that undermine the stated pattern.
actions.implementation: Record absolute or relative tolerances for numeric claims. Compare refreshed evidence with the last approved snapshot; predicate failures and scope changes always override tolerance.
actions.check: A revision below tolerance remains valid with a revision note; accumulated drift beyond tolerance triggers review against the approved baseline.
actions.risk: Loose tolerances can conceal meaningful changes; defaults need analyst approval.

actions.action: Validate charts and callouts against one snapshot
actions.mechanism: Atomic version selection prevents a refreshed chart from being paired with annotation checks from an older dataset.
actions.implementation: Compute chart data and evidence checks using one immutable snapshot token. Invalidate pending export validation whenever its dataset or annotation revision changes.
actions.check: Trigger a refresh between validation and export; export must either retain the validated snapshot or rerun checks on the newer snapshot.
actions.risk: Multiple data sources may require a version manifest rather than one token.

actions.action: Require explicit resolution before clean export
actions.mechanism: A review queue turns detected evidence changes into decisions instead of leaving confident callouts silently visible.
actions.implementation: Highlight contradicted, unavailable, scope-changed, and unverified callouts. Offer edit, remove, or export with an explicit warning; bind decisions to the validated evidence version.
actions.check: Attempt export with a ranking reversal; no unqualified original callout may pass. A later evidence change must invalidate its prior resolution.
actions.risk: Generic acknowledgement buttons encourage rubber-stamping; require a specific disposition.

actions.action: Export evidence provenance alongside visible claims
actions.mechanism: A durable manifest makes exported annotations traceable even after the live dataset and chart have changed.
actions.implementation: Include dataset version, annotation revision, stable metric/filter IDs, resolved dates, evidence values, validation status, and review disposition. Embed a manifest identifier in static exports.
actions.check: Reopen an export independently and identify its exact data version and each callout’s evidence status without consulting the current chart.
actions.risk: Evidence values may be sensitive; apply export permissions to metadata too.
